programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: After Wednesday befriends a new boy her age, Robespierre Courtney, Morticia invites his parents, Mr. and Mrs. Henry Courtney to visit the Addams house for tea. Unbeknownst to them, the Courtney's are hoping to meet a number of the social set.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Uncle Fester incinerates the family's stuffed bear with his flamethrower, Morticia reports the accident to the insurance company. Mr. Henson the head of the company, sends his assistant, Mr. Digby, to handle the case.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Taken in by a psychologist's pronouncement that the only happily married couples are those who fight members of the Addams household devise schemes to start a battle between Gomez (John Astin) and Morticia (Carolyn Jones).

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Pugsley shocks his parents when he gives up his new atomic reactor as kid stuff and announces that he wants to find his own job. His first try is as a medical assistant to Dr. Bird. He turns up, scalpel in hand, ready to help during an operation.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia's favorite charity is having an auction--so Morticia persuades her family to part with things to sell. Donations include Wednesday's headless doll, the old flogging table, a stuffed vulture and Uncle Fester's dynamite.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Cousin Itt is advocated as curator of the local zoo. Gomez uses his influence with Park Commissioner Fisk (guest star Alan Reed) to promote Itt for the job, but the zookeepers are convinced the Addamses' cousin should be confined to a cage.
programme.sub-title: Cousin Itt Visits The Addams Family

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Determined to correct the dreadful literature that Wednesday and Pugsley are exposed to, Morticia sets out to create a new literary world. Gomez fears that his wife's first manuscript is so good, that once the publisher reads it he will lose her.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Lurch becomes inconsolable when Gomez donates the family antique harpsichord to a collector. Gomez and Morticia offer Lurch a balalaika and a set of drums. When this proves unsatisfactory, Gomez and Fester decide to build a new harpsichord.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Gomez decides to bolster Cousin Itt's failing ego by making him the star of a production aimed as a birthday surprise for Wednesday. He hires the great director, Eric von Bissell, who gives Itt elocution lessons, causing a Hollywood star complex.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: While Morticia and Gomez are celebrating their 13th wedding anniversary, she tells Wednesday and Pugsley a bedtime story of how she and Gomez first met. In this episode, Carolyn Jones plays Morticia, Morticia as a 22-year-old, and sister Ophelia.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Wednesday and Pugsley refuse to go to bed until they hear the rest of the courtship story. Morticia resumes the tale via flashback, including the ceremony beginning with Ophelia Frump, Morticia's balmy sister, as the bride.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Allyn Joslyn guest-stars as Sam Hilliard, a former truant officer who now heads a private school where Wednesday and Pugsley are enrolled. When Hilliard breaks under the strain of dealing with the Addams children, Gomez buys the school.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez find Grandfather Pegleg's treasure map and summon Captain Grimby. They hope to charter his boat for the treasure hunt. But after meeting the Captain, Morticia is careful to keep the nature of the mission secret.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Official visitors from an unfriendly nation receive the shock of their lives when they decide to exploit the Addams Family as an average uncultured family. The visitors are shaken up by Morticia's carnivorous plants among other things.
programme.sub-title: The Addams Family Meets The V.I.P.'s

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Fester is so smitten upon receipt of a photo of his love, a bearded carnival lady, that he borrows stamp money to mail her a proposal. Morticia dons a beard and poses as the mother to convince Fester that he will have to work to support a wife.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Because she thinks Fester (Jackie Coogan) and Grandmama (Blossom Rock) are spoiling the children, Morticia (Carolyn Jones) hires a governess. Insulted, Fester paints a white line down the center of the Addams house, dividing it in half.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Uncle Fester's electrical output fails abruptly. Should they call a doctor or an electrician to bring Fester back? Morticia prescribes a bowl of porcupine mold, and both she and Gomez agree that long exposure to moon rays would be beneficial.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia's pet plant Cleopatra gobbles up her favorite photo of Gomez from the family album. When the original photographer is found and asked to make a duplicate picture, it is discovered that he is now with the Department of Motor Vehicles.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Ophelia Frump is madly in love with Horatio Bartholomew, the man who has everything, except the truth about her relatives. Morticia, not convinced by Bartholomew, persuades playboy Cousin Itt to stir the embers of his past romance with Ophelia.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: The family would like to vacation on the moon, but the billion-dollar travel cost is slightly prohibitive. Uncle Fester volunteers $21.13 and Morticia, using Gomez's new supercomputer, suggests placing a $2,000 bet on the daily double horse race.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia's cousin, Melancholia, wants to marry Clarence P. Harvey after most of her marital prospects have joined the Foreign Legion. Clarence recoils when Melancholia puts on a campaign to win him, backed by Morticia, Gomez and Clarence's boss.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Rockland Cartright III is a beatnik who crashes his motorbike into a tree and recuperates at the Addams house. Each regards the other as an oddity, although the family learns to appreciate certain aspects of Rockland's life.
programme.sub-title: The Addams Family Meets A Beatnik

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: In need of artistic fulfillment, Morticia takes up sculpting. An art critic views her first endeavor--a three-eyed Gomez statue--and clubs it with his cane. Gomez, who won't have Morticia's heart broken gets a seedy art dealer to buy it.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Romance seems close for Thing, the Addams right-hand-in-a-box, when Gomez's aunt arrives for a visit accompanied by Lady Fingers, her handmaiden. Thing enjoys the visit most because it gives him a chance to hold hands with one of his own kind.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Uncle Fester applies for a job as an insurance salesman with the same company which is threatening to cancel the Addamses' policy (because Fester keeps blowing things up). Fester convinces the company interviewer that he is qualified for the job.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez see Fester conferring with TV muscleman Jack LaGrann (Jack LaLanne), and think that Fester is planning a television career. However, Uncle Fester confides to Lurch that he has to go on a secret diet and exercise.

But in this unique installment of Interview With a Killer, Gilbert appears to be a far cry from his once golden upbringing. Host David Scott explores his long history of mental illness and the privileged pressure cooker that shaped his downfall.

programme.title: Interview With a Killer
programme.desc: In 2013, the small city of Weatherford, Texas was rocked by the brutal slaying of local son, JD Doss. The murder weapon? A pickaxe. The murderer? His close friend, 24-year-old Nicholas Camfield. In a shocking twist, Camfield not only killed his victim by repeatedly striking him in the head, he also mutilated, scalped, and defiled his body over the course of days. In one of David Scott's most shocking interviews, Camfield gives a glimpse inside his deranged, murderous mind.

programme.title: Interview With a Killer

programme.title: Stomping Grounds
programme.desc: In Stomping Grounds Episode 5, our crew follows the road all the way down to where it ends on the tropical sun-baked island of Key West at the southern tip of the Florida Keys. Surrounded by water, Key West is a boater's paradise with historic seaports and marinas offering a bustling waterfront with historic schooners, dive boats, sport fishing charters, parasailing adventures and scenic coastal excursions. Host Ryan McVinney hops aboard a custom hybrid diesel-electric power catamaran with solar panels, called "Squid" for an in-depth eco-tour of Key West National Wildlife Refuge, including snorkeling in a sponge garden with tropical fish. Next a quick stop in Dry Tortugas National Park via the 110-foot Gladding Hearn power catamaran the "Yankee Freedom III" to visit historic Fort Jefferson, then we jump on a 2020 Sea Hunt 255 Ultra for a ride through the dolphin playground to a secret local boating spot known as Snipe Keys with pristine white sandbars. Back in town we we board the Nau Santa Maria - a replica of Christopher Columbus' sailboat. Finally we head 50 miles offshore to ply the wakes of the shrimp boats with fishing charter captain Chris Trosset aboard his Contender 35ST center console boat.

programme.title: Winchester Life
programme.desc: Col. Nick Nichols from Folds of Honor and Olympic skeet shooter Dania Vizzi are both proud Americans who have represented their country overseas. Col. Now with Winchesters in hand, both are in the Midwest whitetail woods during late November during the back end of the rut hoping to connect on a Missouri monarch.

programme.title: Wilderness Chronicles
programme.desc: There’s something out there in the woods. People say it walks on two legs, has the body of a man, and the head of a wolf. They call it... the Dogman. In this episode of Wilderness Chronicles, Kyle dives into one of the most talked-about cryptids in North American Midwest — the Michigan Dogman. Kyle explores real eyewitness accounts, mysterious sightings, and the strange history of Dogman reports across Michigan and other parts of the country! If you're into cryptid legends, scary stories, and outdoor mysteries, this one’s for you.

programme.title: Wilderness Chronicles
programme.desc: In 2003, Brett Mann and two friends were stranded in the flooded wilds of northern Australia. When Brett swam for help, he was taken by a massive crocodile. But the true horror came next. For nearly 24 hours, the crocodile returned—again and again—carrying Brett’s body, circling the tree where his friends clung to life. It wasn’t just hunting. It was showing them something. Was this predator defending its territory? Sending a message? Or acting with something more than instinct?In this episode of The Wilderness Chronicles, we examine the terrifying true story of Brett Mann—and ask:When nature strikes back… is it ever personal?

programme.title: Wilderness Chronicles
programme.desc: Could dinosaurs still walk the Earth? Deep in the Congo, legends say yes. In this episode of The Wilderness Chronicles, Kyle Green investigates the chilling reports of Mokele-mbembe, a dinosaur-like creature said to inhabit the remote swamps of the Congo Basin. We dive into real expedition footage, indigenous stories, and eyewitness accounts that all point to one shocking possibility: something ancient may still be alive in the heart of Africa. From early missionary reports in the 1900s to modern explorers risking their lives to chase the unknown, we piece together the long-standing mystery surrounding alleged dinosaur sightings in Africa. Whether you're into cryptids, paleontology, or just love a good wilderness mystery, this episode will have you questioning what’s really hiding in the unexplored corners of the Earth.

programme.desc: Tom has been profiled in People magazine, called "gut-busting hilarious" by The New York Times, and given a perfect 4-star rating by the New York Post. He's been featured on radio shows from Hollywood to Dollywood, including "Bob&Tom", Johnboy & Billy "BillHandel" and "Drew&Mike". Chances are you also know Tom as the star of CMT's hit comedy series, "Mabe in America", or have watched one of his popular viral videos. With more than 50-million views on YouTube, Tom is one of the most downloaded people on the planet. People love Tom's stories about coping with life's challenges, ranging from a child with a microscopic attention span to a family vacation in a minivan that takes a wrong turn. His original songs, stories, and videos make for a night out you will remember for years.

His smooth delivery and? powerful punchlines make him a force in stand-up comedy, which is very apparent in his debut album "The Things We Tell Ourselves", available now on iTunes and Amazon. Mike has opened for comedians like Damon Wayans, Cash Cab's Ben Baily, Jon Lovitz, and Saturday Night Live's Jay Pharoah.

She's assisted by Dokgo Cheol (Song Seung Heon), a former violent crimes detective who got demoted to traffic duty... and who shares a mysterious past connection with Se Ra. To both Cheong Ja and Cheol's surprise, they begin to fall for each other, sending their lives onto an entirely new trajectory.

programme.title: Stomping Grounds
programme.sub-title: Stomping Grounds - "Key West - A Boater's Paradise
programme.desc: In Stomping Grounds Episode 5, our crew follows the road all the way down to where it ends on the tropical sun-baked island of Key West at the southern tip of the Florida Keys. Surrounded by water, Key West is a boater's paradise with historic seaports and marinas offering a bustling waterfront with historic schooners, dive boats, sport fishing charters, parasailing adventures and scenic coastal excursions. Host Ryan McVinney hops aboard a custom hybrid diesel-electric power catamaran with solar panels, called "Squid" for an in-depth eco-tour of Key West National Wildlife Refuge, including snorkeling in a sponge garden with tropical fish. Next a quick stop in Dry Tortugas National Park via the 110-foot Gladding Hearn power catamaran the "Yankee Freedom III" to visit historic Fort Jefferson, then we jump on a 2020 Sea Hunt 255 Ultra for a ride through the dolphin playground to a secret local boating spot known as Snipe Keys with pristine white sandbars. Back in town we we board the Nau Santa Maria - a replica of Christopher Columbus' sailboat. Finally we head 50 miles offshore to ply the wakes of the shrimp boats with fishing charter captain Chris Trosset aboard his Contender 35ST center console boat.

programme.title: Sor Batalla
programme.desc: Una monja es enviada a un pueblo lejano, gobernado por un hombre malvado, y con su fe y alegría intenta cambiarlo.

programme.title: La hija sin padre
programme.desc: Una joven cantante se enamora de un hombre y se casa, pero este niega ser el padre de la criatura que ella espera.

programme.title: Escuadrón salvaje
programme.desc: Los juegos de guerra se tornan mortales para un grupo de jóvenes, cuya alegre excursión culmina en una casa abandonada.

programme.title: Ha entrado una mujer
programme.desc: Una mujer que no pudo tener consigo a su hijo de pequeño lo encuentra de joven y lucha para ganar su aprecio.

programme.title: Asesinos comerciantes de niños
programme.desc: Los padres de un niño secuestrado se enfrentan a una banda criminal que trafica con órganos humanos de menores.

programme.title: Huevos rancheros
programme.desc: Una mujer le es infiel a su esposo porque ella cree que de esa manera le evitará una muerte sangrienta.

programme.title: La casa que arde de noche
programme.desc: Una prostituta ingresa en un burdel y establece una rivalidad con la dueña del lugar. Luego, trata de arrebatarle el negocio y al amante a la anciana propietaria.

programme.title: Camino al infierno
programme.desc: Tres ex convictos continúan sus vidas en el crimen, ya que al salir de la cárcel violan y matan a un grupo de turistas.

programme.title: El Mofles y Canek en máscara vs cabellera
programme.desc: Un mecánico inexperto en el deporte de la lucha libre vive toda una aventura cuando se enfrenta a un luchador asesino.

programme.title: El caudillo
programme.desc: Un valiente revolucionario es buscado por las tropas federales, pero el pueblo lo ayuda a esconderse y luego a escapar.

programme.title: Mágico, el Enviado de los Dioses
programme.desc: Un héroe enmascarado llamado Mágico llega a la Tierra para pelear contra una fuerza maléfica y defender a los necesitados.

programme.title: La Chamuscada
programme.desc: Un peón se une a la revolución y llega a ser coronel de las tropas zapatistas después de huir del maltrato de su patrón.

programme.title: Operación 67
programme.desc: Una banda oriental intenta falsificar las placas con que se imprimen los billetes de un país latino para desestabilizarlo.

programme.title: El Quelite
programme.desc: Un hombre tiene una sensación extraña cada vez que escucha la música de una canción.

programme.title: Juan Nadie
programme.desc: Juan Nadie es un pistolero al que contratan para matar a un cacique. Juan lo hace y la viuda de este pone precio a su cabeza. Su mala fama lo lleva a ser perseguido por una banda.

programme.title: Esposa te doy
programme.desc: Sofía y Alberto, son una pareja de recién casados que descubren que además de amor también hay diferencias en el matrimonio, sin embargo, comienzan a vivir con ellas pretendiendo no darles importancia, pero la tensión comienza a subir de tono.

programme.title: La sombra del Caudillo
programme.desc: El Caudillo no se detiene ante nada en su búsqueda por el poder, valiéndose de la corrupción, la amenaza y el asesinato.

programme.title: El gran Makakikus
programme.desc: Un marqués arruinado pide la mano de una joven para aprovecharse de su familia, pero ella está enamorada de un charro.

programme.title: Antesala de la silla eléctrica
programme.desc: Un joven inocente es sentenciado a la silla eléctrica, pero el teniente que lo capturó intenta ayudarlo.

programme.title: El Tejedor de Milagros
programme.desc: En Navidad, un indio llega a un pueblo con su esposa embarazada; pero como nadie los ayuda ella da a luz en plena calle.

programme.title: La mesera del café del puerto
programme.desc: Una mesera coja ayuda a un compositor que está en la ruina, logrando superarse y triunfar, luego ella se somete a una cirugía y deciden casarse.

programme.title: Los hijos de Don Venancio
programme.desc: Un comerciante queda viudo con cinco hijos a su cargo, quienes le dan severos problemas con su comportamiento.

programme.title: El hombre de la isla
programme.desc: Una mujer va a una isla remota para casarse con un hombre que al principio la maltrata, pero al fin se enamora de ella.

programme.title: Rancho de mis recuerdos
programme.desc: Un caporal se luce en una fiesta brava junto a un torero andaluz y la hija del hacendado les hace competencia.

programme.title: Azahares para tu boda
programme.desc: La hija de una familia conservadora va a casarse, pero el novio socialista no acepta hacerlo por la iglesia.

programme.title: Muertos de miedo
programme.desc: Una joven contrata a dos detectives privados para encontrar a un famoso ladrón de joyas, conocido como Rostov.

programme.title: El pequeño ruiseñor
programme.desc: Un pequeño monaguillo tiene una voz prodigiosa así que en complicidad con el sacristán canta en bodas y bautizos.

programme.title: Vivir del cuento
programme.desc: Un empleado usa el nombre de su patrón para cometer fraude y es despedido, pero a su vez el patrón engaña a su ex-suegro.
